gold: Masquerading bundle-branch block (MBBB) with progression to advanced atrioventricular block

selector.rationale: Prolonged QRS duration and notched and monophasic R-wave in V1 support Left Bundle Branch Block, while echocardiogram findings of ejection fraction and left ventricular hypocontractility support Left ventricular dysfunction

rejected.label: Dilated Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Similar echocardiogram findings, but less specific than Left ventricular dysfunction

rejected.label: Prosthetic Valve Thrombosis
rejected.why: No direct evidence of valve thrombosis in current presentation

rejected.label: High-degree atrioventricular (AV) block
rejected.why: Prolonged PR interval, but no evidence of high-degree AV block on 24-hour Holter monitoring
